# FutureFlow

> FutureFlow is an AI-powered personal finance platform that unifies bank accounts, predicts cash flow, automates subscription management, cancels unwanted subscriptions, and files taxes — all in one app. Pre-launch, waitlist open. Boston-based startup launching in 2026.

## Overview

FutureFlow replaces the fragmented mess of multiple finance apps (Mint, YNAB, TurboTax, Rocket Money, etc.) with a single AI-powered platform that does everything automatically. The mission is to make financial wellness radically accessible.

- **Website:** https://www.joinfutureflow.com
- **Contact:** help@joinfutureflow.com
- **Status:** Pre-launch — accepting waitlist signups for 2026 launch
- **Founded:** Boston, MA
- **Privacy:** 100% ad-free, never sells user data, 256-bit AES encryption, read-only Plaid connections

---

## Core Features (The 6 Pillars)

### Pillar 1 — Connect Everything
Connects 12,000+ banks, brokerages, and email accounts via Plaid. Real-time unified dashboard with zero manual setup.

### Pillar 2 — Predict Problems
AI forecasts cash flow 30 days ahead, flags risks before they happen, and spots hidden savings automatically.

### Pillar 3 — Act Automatically
Cancels subscriptions, executes savings transfers, files taxes — 100% automated with no effort required from the user.

### Pillar 4 — Subscription Radar (Exclusive)
Detects every subscription via Plaid + email scanning. Alerts before charges hit. One-tap AI cancellation — no phone calls required. Finds an average $312/month in hidden subscriptions.

### Pillar 5 — AI Tax Engine (Exclusive)
Autonomous tax harvesting and filing across all 50 US states. Also covers Canada. Proactive anomaly detection.

### Pillar 6 — Portfolio & Bill Splitting (Exclusive)
Portfolio Health Radar links investments to real cash flow. Fraud-proof Bill Splitting uses real bank transactions rather than estimates.

---

## Pricing

### Free Plan — $0/month
No credit card required. No commitment.
Includes: Spending analytics, auto categorisation, up to 2 connected accounts, monthly budget overview, basic savings goals, email support.

### Pro Plan — $14.99/month (Most Popular)
30-day free trial. No charge until trial ends.
Includes everything in Free, plus: Email + Expense Radar, free trial ending alerts, portfolio health radar, bill splitting, autonomous tax engine, US & Canada tax guidance, unlimited connected accounts, AI subscription manager, debt payoff planner, cash flow forecasting, bill & due date alerts, credit score monitor, net worth tracker, investment tracking, priority support.

Average Pro user saves over $1,200/year. At $14.99/month, FutureFlow pays for itself many times over.

### Household Plan — $19.99/month
30-day free trial. Same as Pro — built for two users.
Includes everything in Pro, plus: 2-user family access, shared goals and insights as a family.

## Comparison vs. Competitors

FutureFlow is the only personal finance platform with all of: Email + Expense Radar, Free Trial Ending Alerts, Fraud-proof Bill Splitting, Portfolio Health Radar, Autonomous Tax Engine, US & Canada Tax Guidance, and a free tier — in one app.

Competitors compared: Monarch Money, Rocket Money, Copilot Money, YNAB, PocketGuard.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is my financial data safe?**
Yes. FutureFlow uses 256-bit AES encryption and connects to your accounts via Plaid — a bank-grade, read-only connection. We never store your banking credentials.

**Can I cancel anytime?**
Absolutely. Cancel at any time from your account settings with no cancellation fees. You keep access until the end of your billing period.

**How does the 30-day free trial work?**
Pro and Household plans include a 30-day free trial. No charge until the trial ends, and you can cancel before then with zero fees.

**How does bill negotiation work?**
Our AI calls your service providers and negotiates lower rates. We only charge a success fee — 40% of first-year savings — if we actually succeed.

**Does FutureFlow sell my data?**
Never. We are 100% ad-free and never sell user data to third parties. Our revenue comes from subscriptions only.

**When does FutureFlow launch?**
We are accepting waitlist signups now and plan to launch publicly in 2026. Join the waitlist for early access and a free extended trial.
